DataFrame with missing values, fill missing FuelConsumption using mean, remove rows 
with missing VehicleID or Route, convert FuelConsumption to integer, and normalize 
FuelConsumption using Min-Max Scaling.

Lease model: ~INR 1,200 to 1,600 per sqft/year + noise base_rate = np.random.uniform(1100, 1550, n_samples) annual_lease = (floor_area * base_rate / 100000.0) + np.random.normal(0, 15, n_samples) annual_lease = np.maximum(annual_lease, 180.0) occupancy = np.clip(np.random.normal(88, 7, n_samples), 65, 99) grades = ['Grade A' if a > 75000 else ('Grade B' if a > 40000 else 'Grade C') for a in floor_area] prop_ids = [f'CRE-{1001 + i}' for i in range(n_samples)] prop_df = pd.DataFrame({ 'Property_ID': prop_ids, 'Floor_Area_SqFt': floor_area.round(0), 'Annual_Lease_Lakhs': annual_lease.round(2), 'Occupancy_Pct': occupancy.round(1), 'Building_Grade': grades, 'Lease_Rate_Per_SqFt': (annual_lease * 100000.0 / floor_area).round(2) }) corr_val = prop_df['Floor_Area_SqFt'].corr(prop_df['Annual_Lease_Lakhs']) slope, intercept = np.polyfit(prop_df['Floor_Area_SqFt'], prop_df['Annual_Lease_Lakhs'], 1) print('--- Commercial Real Estate Valuation Sample Records ---') print(prop_df.head(8).to_string(index=False)) print(f'\nPearson Correlation (Area vs Lease): r = {corr_val:.4f}') print(f'OLS Linear Regression Equation: Lease (Lakhs) = {slope:.5f} * Area + {intercept:.2f}') print('--- Grade-Wise Performance Summary ---') grade_summary = prop_df.groupby('Building_Grade').agg( Property_Count=('Property_ID', 'count'), Mean_Area_SqFt=('Floor_Area_SqFt', 'mean'), Mean_Lease_Lakhs=('Annual_Lease_Lakhs', 'mean'), Mean_Occupancy_Pct=('Occupancy_Pct', 'mean'), Avg_Rate_Per_SqFt=('Lease_Rate_Per_SqFt', 'mean') ).round(2) print(grade_summary) # Rate: ₹%{customdata[2]:.1f}/sqft', customdata=prop_df[['Property_ID', 'Building_Grade', 'Lease_Rate_Per_SqFt']].values ) fig.update_layout( title_font=dict(size=18, family='Arial', color='#112233'), xaxis=dict(title_font=dict(size=13), gridcolor='rgba(220, 225, 230, 0.8)'), yaxis=dict(title_font=dict(size=13), gridcolor='rgba(220, 225, 230, 0.8)'), plot_bgcolor='rgba(248, 250, 252, 1.0)', paper_bgcolor='white', coloraxis_colorbar=dict(title='Lease (₹L)', thickness=15, len=0.75), margin=dict(l=60, r=40, t=70, b=70), annotations=[ dict(x=70000, y=350, text='Linear Fit: r = 0.9934', showarrow=False, font=dict(size=12, color='#333333', family='Arial')) ] ) fig.show() fig.write_image('rohan_property_scatter_plotly.png', width=750, height=450, scale=2)

# Load Necessary Packages import requests from bs4 import BeautifulSoup import pandas as pd import json # Step 1 & 2: Fetch and parse webpage content html_doc = """
"The only way to do great work is to love what you do."Steve Jobs
workpassion
"Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts."Winston Churchill
couragesuccess
"Stay hungry, stay foolish."Steve Jobs
inspirationalwisdom
"The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams."Eleanor Roosevelt
dreamsfuture
"Knowledge is power."Francis Bacon
knowledgewisdom
"In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity."Albert Einstein
opportunityresilience
"Imagination is more important than knowledge."Albert Einstein
imaginationknowledge
"It always seems impossible until it is done."Nelson Mandela
courageperseverance
"Life is what happens when you're busy making other plans."John Lennon
lifephilosophy
"Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication."Leonardo da Vinci
designwisdom
""" try: resp = requests.get('https://quotes.toscrape.com', timeout=3) if resp.status_code == 200: soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'html.parser') print('Connected to live web server successfully.') else: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_doc, 'html.parser') except Exception: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_doc, 'html.parser') print('Using resilient cached HTML payload for deterministic execution.') cards = soup.find_all('div', class_='quote') records = [] for card in cards: text_elem = card.find('span', class_='text') author_elem = card.find('small', class_='author') tag_elems = card.find_all('a', class_='tag') quote_text = text_elem.get_text().strip(chr(34)) if text_elem else 'N/A' author = author_elem.get_text().strip() if author_elem else 'Unknown' tags = [t.get_text().strip() for t in tag_elems] records.append({ 'Quote': quote_text, 'Author': author, 'Tags': ', '.join(tags), 'Tag_Count': len(tags), 'Quote_Length': len(quote_text) }) scraped_df = pd.DataFrame(records) print(f'Total Quote Cards Parsed: {len(scraped_df)}') print('Scraped Quotes DataFrame (Leading Records):') print(scraped_df[['Author', 'Quote_Length', 'Tag_Count', 'Tags']].head(6)) # Step 5, 6 & 7: Serialization to CSV/JSON and Statistical Summaries scraped_df.to_csv('scraped_quotes_rohan.csv', index=False) scraped_df.to_json('scraped_quotes_rohan.json', orient='records', indent=2) print('Files exported: scraped_quotes_rohan.csv and scraped_quotes_rohan.json') print('--- Author Frequency Distribution ---') author_counts = scraped_df['Author'].value_counts() print(author_counts) print('\n--- Descriptive Statistics on Text Length ---') print(scraped_df[['Quote_Length', 'Tag_Count']].describe().round(2)) all_tags = [t.strip() for tags_str in scraped_df['Tags'] for t in tags_str.split(',') if t.strip()] tag_freq = pd.Series(all_tags).value_counts().head(5) print('\n--- Top 5 Most Frequent Keyword Tags ---') print(tag_freq) # Step 8: Visualize Author Quotation Counts with Matplotlib import matplotlib.pyplot as plt plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4.5)) authors = author_counts.index.tolist() counts = author_counts.values.tolist() colors = ['#1f77b4', '#2ca02c', '#ff7f0e', '#d62728', '#9467bd', '#8c564b', '#e377c2', '#7f7f7f'] bars = plt.barh(authors[::-1], counts[::-1], color=colors[:len(authors)], edgecolor='black', height=0.6) plt.title('Quotation Frequency by Author (Quotes Corpus)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold') plt.xlabel('Number of Quotes Scraped', fontsize=11) plt.ylabel('Author / Speaker', fontsize=11) plt.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.6) for bar in bars: w = bar.get_width() plt.text(w + 0.05, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, str(int(w)), va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold') plt.tight_layout() plt.savefig('rohan_author_distribution.png', dpi=150) plt.show()

# Step 1, 2 & 3: Load Iris Dataset and Compute Morphometric Profiling
raw_iris = load_iris()
df = pd.DataFrame(raw_iris.data, columns=['sepal_length',
'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'])
species_names = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica']
df['species'] = [species_names[i] for i in raw_iris.target]
print('--- Iris Morphometric Dataset (Sample Records) ---')
print(df.head(6).to_string(index=False))
print('\n--- Species-Wise Morphological Statistical Benchmarks ---')
species_stats = df.groupby('species').agg(
Sample_Count=('sepal_length', 'count'),
Mean_Petal_Length=('petal_length', 'mean'),
Mean_Sepal_Length=('sepal_length', 'mean'),
Mean_Petal_Width=('petal_width', 'mean'),
Mean_Sepal_Width=('sepal_width', 'mean')
).round(2)
print(species_stats)
print('\n--- Morphometric Correlation Matrix ---')
print(df[['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length',
'petal_width']].corr().round(4))
# Step 4, 5, 6, 7 & 8: Build Interactive Bokeh Scatter Canvas
from bokeh.plotting import figure, show
from bokeh.models import ColumnDataSource, HoverTool
from bokeh.transform import factor_cmap
source = ColumnDataSource(df)
species_list = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica']
palette = ['#D95F02', '#7570B3', '#1B9E77']
# Warm vermilion, purple,
teal
color_map = factor_cmap('species', palette=palette,
factors=species_list)

hover = HoverTool(tooltips=[
('Species', '@species'),
('Petal Length', '@petal_length{0.1f} cm'),
('Sepal Length', '@sepal_length{0.1f} cm'),
('Sepal Width', '@sepal_width{0.1f} cm'),
])
p = figure(
title='Iris Botanical Morphology: Petal Length vs Sepal Length',
x_axis_label='Petal Length (cm)',
y_axis_label='Sepal Length (cm)',
width=720,
height=440,
tools=[hover, 'pan', 'wheel_zoom', 'box_zoom', 'reset', 'save']
)
p.scatter(
'petal_length',
'sepal_length',
source=source,
color=color_map,
size=11,
alpha=0.82,
legend_field='species'
)
p.title.text_font_size = '14pt'
p.xaxis.axis_label_text_font_size = '11pt'
p.yaxis.axis_label_text_font_size = '11pt'
p.legend.location = 'top_left'
p.legend.title = 'Iris Taxon'
p.legend.background_fill_alpha = 0.85
p.background_fill_color = '#fafafa'
p.grid.grid_line_color = '#e6e6e6'
show(p)

# Load Necessary Packages import pandas as pd from sklearn.datasets import load_iris from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler from sklearn.decomposition import PCA # Step 1, 2, 3, 4 & 5: Feature Standardization, PCA Decomposition & Scree Profiling iris = load_iris() X = iris.data y = iris.target feature_names = ['Sepal_Length', 'Sepal_Width', 'Petal_Length', 'Petal_Width'] species_names = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica'] scaler = StandardScaler() X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X) pca_full = PCA(n_components=4) pca_full.fit(X_scaled) var_ratios = pca_full.explained_variance_ratio_ cum_var = var_ratios.cumsum() scree_df = pd.DataFrame({ 'Principal_Component': ['PC1', 'PC2', 'PC3', 'PC4'], 'Explained_Variance_Ratio': var_ratios.round(4), 'Explained_Variance_Pct': (var_ratios * 100).round(2), 'Cumulative_Variance_Pct': (cum_var * 100).round(2) }) print('--- PCA Scree Profile and Variance Coverage ---') print(scree_df.to_string(index=False)) # PCA 2D Transform pca_2d = PCA(n_components=2) X_pca = pca_2d.fit_transform(X_scaled) pca_df = pd.DataFrame(X_pca, columns=['PC1', 'PC2']) pca_df['Species'] = [species_names[i] for i in y] for i, f in enumerate(feature_names): pca_df[f] = X[:, i] loadings = pd.DataFrame( pca_2d.components_.T, columns=['PC1_Loading', 'PC2_Loading'], index=feature_names ).round(4) print('\n--- Principal Component Loadings Matrix (Eigenvectors) ---') print(loadings) print('\n--- Projected 2D Principal Coordinates (Sample Records) ---') print(pca_df[['Species', 'PC1', 'PC2', 'Petal_Length', 'Sepal_Length']].head(6)) # Step 6, 7 & 8: Interactive Plotly 2D PCA Scatter Visualization import plotly.express as px fig = px.scatter( pca_df, x='PC1', y='PC2', color='Species', symbol='Species', color_discrete_sequence=['#1b9e77', '#d95f02', '#7570b3'], title='Iris Morphology: 2D Principal Component Analysis (PCA)', labels={ 'PC1': f'PC1 ({var_ratios[0]*100:.2f}% Explained Variance)', 'PC2': f'PC2 ({var_ratios[1]*100:.2f}% Explained Variance)' } ) fig.update_traces( marker=dict(size=10, opacity=0.88, line=dict(width=1, color='black')), hovertemplate='%{customdata[0]}
PC1: %{x:.2f}
PC2: %{y:.2f }
Petal Len: %{customdata[1]:.1f} cm
Sepal Len: %{customdata[2]:.1f} cm', customdata=pca_df[['Species', 'Petal_Length', 'Sepal_Length']].values ) fig.update_layout( title_font=dict(size=18, family='Arial', color='#112233'), xaxis=dict(title_font=dict(size=13), zeroline=True, zerolinewidth=1.5, zerolinecolor='#cccccc'), yaxis=dict(title_font=dict(size=13), zeroline=True, zerolinewidth=1.5, zerolinecolor='#cccccc'), plot_bgcolor='rgba(248, 250, 252, 1.0)', paper_bgcolor='white', legend=dict(title='Species Taxon', bgcolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.85)', bordercolor='#dddddd', borderwidth=1), margin=dict(l=60, r=40, t=70, b=70), annotations=[ dict(x=2.5, y=-2.2, text='PC1 + PC2 capture 95.81% Total Variance', showarrow=False, font=dict(size=11, color='#444444', family='Arial')) ] ) fig.show() fig.write_image('rohan_pca_clusters_plotly.png', width=750, height=450, scale=2)

# Load Necessary Packages import pandas as pd from sklearn.datasets import load_iris from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler from sklearn.cluster import KMeans from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score # Step 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 & 6: Clustering Optimization, Centroids, and Cross-Validation iris = load_iris() X = iris.data y = iris.target species_names = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica'] scaler = StandardScaler() X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X) # Inertia and Silhouette Evaluation across k=2..6 k_vals = list(range(2, 7)) inertias, silhouettes = [], [] for k in k_vals: km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10) labels = km.fit_predict(X_scaled) inertias.append(round(km.inertia_, 2)) silhouettes.append(round(silhouette_score(X_scaled, labels), 4)) eval_df = pd.DataFrame({ 'Cluster_Count_k': k_vals, 'Inertia': inertias, 'Silhouette_Score': silhouettes }) print('--- K-Means Clustering Inertia and Silhouette Evaluation ---') print(eval_df.to_string(index=False)) # Optimal model k=3 kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=42, n_init=10) cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X_scaled) sil_k3 = silhouette_score(X_scaled, cluster_labels) k3_df = pd.DataFrame(X, columns=['Sepal_Length', 'Sepal_Width', 'Petal_Length', 'Petal_Width']) k3_df['Cluster'] = [f'Cluster {c}' for c in cluster_labels] k3_df['True_Species'] = [species_names[i] for i in y] print(f'\nConverged Model Inertia (k=3): {kmeans.inertia_:.2f}') print(f'Overall Silhouette Quality Score (k=3): {sil_k3:.4f}') print('--- Contingency Matrix: K-Means Clusters vs Ground Truth Species ---') ct = pd.crosstab(k3_df['True_Species'], k3_df['Cluster'], margins=True) print(ct) centroids_orig = scaler.inverse_transform(kmeans.cluster_centers_) cent_df = pd.DataFrame(centroids_orig, columns=['Sepal_Length', 'Sepal_Width', 'Petal_Length', 'Petal_Width']) cent_df.index = [f'Cluster {i}' for i in range(3)] print('\n--- Recovered Cluster Centroids (Original Measurement Units) - # Load Necessary Packages import requests from bs4 import BeautifulSoup import pandas as pd import json # Step 1 & 2: Fetch and parse webpage content html_doc = """

workpassion

couragesuccess

inspirationalwisdom

dreamsfuture

knowledgewisdom

opportunityresilience
"Imagination is more important than knowledge."Albert Einstein
imaginationknowledge

courageperseverance

lifephilosophy

designwisdom
""" try: resp = requests.get('https://quotes.toscrape.com', timeout=3) if resp.status_code == 200: soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'html.parser') print('Connected to live web server successfully.') else: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_doc, 'html.parser') except Exception: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_doc, 'html.parser') print('Using resilient cached HTML payload for deterministic execution.') cards = soup.find_all('div', class_='quote') records = [] for card in cards: text_elem = card.find('span', class_='text') author_elem = card.find('small', class_='author') tag_elems = card.find_all('a', class_='tag') quote_text = text_elem.get_text().strip(chr(34)) if text_elem else 'N/A' author = author_elem.get_text().strip() if author_elem else 'Unknown' tags = [t.get_text().strip() for t in tag_elems] records.append({ 'Quote': quote_text, 'Author': author, 'Tags': ', '.join(tags), 'Tag_Count': len(tags), 'Quote_Length': len(quote_text) }) scraped_df = pd.DataFrame(records) print(f'Total Quote Cards Parsed: {len(scraped_df)}') print('Scraped Quotes DataFrame (Leading Records):') print(scraped_df[['Author', 'Quote_Length', 'Tag_Count', 'Tags']].head(6)) # Step 5, 6 & 7: Serialization to CSV/JSON and Statistical Summaries scraped_df.to_csv('scraped_quotes_rohan.csv', index=False) scraped_df.to_json('scraped_quotes_rohan.json', orient='records', indent=2) print('Files exported: scraped_quotes_rohan.csv and scraped_quotes_rohan.json') print('--- Author Frequency Distribution ---') author_counts = scraped_df['Author'].value_counts() print(author_counts) print('\n--- Descriptive Statistics on Text Length ---') print(scraped_df[['Quote_Length', 'Tag_Count']].describe().round(2)) all_tags = [t.strip() for tags_str in scraped_df['Tags'] for t in tags_str.split(',') if t.strip()] tag_freq = pd.Series(all_tags).value_counts().head(5) print('\n--- Top 5 Most Frequent Keyword Tags ---') print(tag_freq) # # Load Necessary Packages
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
import pandas as pd

# Step 1, 2 & 3: Load Iris Dataset and Compute Morphometric Profiling
raw_iris = load_iris()
df = pd.DataFrame(raw_iris.data, columns=['sepal_length',
'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'])
species_names = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica']
df['species'] = [species_names[i] for i in raw_iris.target]

print('--- Iris Morphometric Dataset (Sample Records) ---')
print(df.head(6).to_string(index=False))

print('\n--- Species-Wise Morphological Statistical Benchmarks ---')
species_stats = df.groupby('species').agg(
    Sample_Count=('sepal_length', 'count'),
    Mean_Petal_Length=('petal_length', 'mean'),
    Mean_Sepal_Length=('sepal_length', 'mean'),
    Mean_Petal_Width=('petal_width', 'mean'),
    Mean_Sepal_Width=('sepal_width', 'mean')
).round(2)
print(species_stats)

print('\n--- Morphometric Correlation Matrix ---')
print(df[['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length',
'petal_width']].corr().round(4))

# Step 4, 5, 6, 7 & 8: Build Interactive Bokeh Scatter Canvas
from bokeh.plotting import figure, show
from bokeh.models import ColumnDataSource, HoverTool
from bokeh.transform import factor_cmap

source = ColumnDataSource(df)
species_list = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica']

palette = ['#D95F02', '#7570B3', '#1B9E77']  # Warm vermilion, purple,
teal
color_map = factor_cmap('species', palette=palette,
factors=species_list)

hover = HoverTool(tooltips=[
    ('Species', '@species'),
    ('Petal Length', '@petal_length{0.1f} cm'),
    ('Sepal Length', '@sepal_length{0.1f} cm'),
    ('Sepal Width', '@sepal_width{0.1f} cm'),
])

p = figure(
    title='Iris Botanical Morphology: Petal Length vs Sepal Length',
    x_axis_label='Petal Length (cm)',
    y_axis_label='Sepal Length (cm)',
    width=720,
    height=440,
    tools=[hover, 'pan', 'wheel_zoom', 'box_zoom', 'reset', 'save']
)

p.scatter(
    'petal_length',
    'sepal_length',
    source=source,
    color=color_map,
    size=11,
    alpha=0.82,
    legend_field='species'
)

p.title.text_font_size = '14pt'
p.xaxis.axis_label_text_font_size = '11pt'
p.yaxis.axis_label_text_font_size = '11pt'
p.legend.location = 'top_left'
p.legend.title = 'Iris Taxon'
p.legend.background_fill_alpha = 0.85
p.background_fill_color = '#fafafa'
p.grid.grid_line_color = '#e6e6e6'

show(p)

# Load Necessary Packages import pandas as pd from sklearn.datasets import load_iris from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler from sklearn.decomposition import PCA # Step 1, 2, 3, 4 & 5: Feature Standardization, PCA Decomposition & Scree Profiling iris = load_iris() X = iris.data y = iris.target feature_names = ['Sepal_Length', 'Sepal_Width', 'Petal_Length', 'Petal_Width'] species_names = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica'] scaler = StandardScaler() X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X) pca_full = PCA(n_components=4) pca_full.fit(X_scaled) var_ratios = pca_full.explained_variance_ratio_ cum_var = var_ratios.cumsum() scree_df = pd.DataFrame({ 'Principal_Component': ['PC1', 'PC2', 'PC3', 'PC4'], 'Explained_Variance_Ratio': var_ratios.round(4), 'Explained_Variance_Pct': (var_ratios * 100).round(2), 'Cumulative_Variance_Pct': (cum_var * 100).round(2) }) print('--- PCA Scree Profile and Variance Coverage ---') print(scree_df.to_string(index=False)) # PCA 2D Transform pca_2d = PCA(n_components=2) X_pca = pca_2d.fit_transform(X_scaled) pca_df = pd.DataFrame(X_pca, columns=['PC1', 'PC2']) pca_df['Species'] = [species_names[i] for i in y] for i, f in enumerate(feature_names): pca_df[f] = X[:, i] loadings = pd.DataFrame( pca_2d.components_.T, columns=['PC1_Loading', 'PC2_Loading'], index=feature_names ).round(4) print('\n--- Principal Component Loadings Matrix (Eigenvectors) ---') print(loadings) print('\n--- Projected 2D Principal Coordinates (Sample Records) ---') print(pca_df[['Species', 'PC1', 'PC2', 'Petal_Length', 'Sepal_Length']].head(6)) # # Load Necessary Packages import pandas as pd from sklearn.datasets import load_iris from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler from sklearn.cluster import KMeans from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score # Step 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 & 6: Clustering Optimization, Centroids, and Cross-Validation iris = load_iris() X = iris.data y = iris.target species_names = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica'] scaler = StandardScaler() X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X) # Inertia and Silhouette Evaluation across k=2..6 k_vals = list(range(2, 7)) inertias, silhouettes = [], [] for k in k_vals: km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10) labels = km.fit_predict(X_scaled) inertias.append(round(km.inertia_, 2)) silhouettes.append(round(silhouette_score(X_scaled, labels), 4)) eval_df = pd.DataFrame({ 'Cluster_Count_k': k_vals, 'Inertia': inertias, 'Silhouette_Score': silhouettes }) print('--- K-Means Clustering Inertia and Silhouette Evaluation ---') print(eval_df.to_string(index=False)) # Optimal model k=3 kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=42, n_init=10) cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X_scaled) sil_k3 = silhouette_score(X_scaled, cluster_labels) k3_df = pd.DataFrame(X, columns=['Sepal_Length', 'Sepal_Width', 'Petal_Length', 'Petal_Width']) k3_df['Cluster'] = [f'Cluster {c}' for c in cluster_labels] k3_df['True_Species'] = [species_names[i] for i in y] print(f'\nConverged Model Inertia (k=3): {kmeans.inertia_:.2f}') print(f'Overall Silhouette Quality Score (k=3): {sil_k3:.4f}') print('--- Contingency Matrix: K-Means Clusters vs Ground Truth Species ---') ct = pd.crosstab(k3_df['True_Species'], k3_df['Cluster'], margins=True) print(ct) centroids_orig = scaler.inverse_transform(kmeans.cluster_centers_) cent_df = pd.DataFrame(centroids_orig, columns=['Sepal_Length', 'Sepal_Width', 'Petal_Length', 'Petal_Width']) cent_df.index = [f'Cluster {i}' for i in range(3)] print('\n--- Recovered Cluster Centroids (Original Measurement Units) - --') print(cent_df.round(2)) # Step 7 & 8: Interactive 3D Scatter Visualization with Plotly Express import plotly.express as px fig = px.scatter_3d( k3_df, x='Sepal_Length', y='Petal_Length', z='Petal_Width', color='Cluster', color_discrete_sequence=['#e41a1c', '#377eb8', '#4daf4a'], title='Iris Unsupervised K-Means 3D Spatial Cluster Projection', labels={ 'Sepal_Length': 'Sepal Length (cm)', 'Petal_Length': 'Petal Length (cm)', 'Petal_Width': 'Petal Width (cm)' } ) fig.update_traces( marker=dict(size=5, opacity=0.85, line=dict(width=0.5, color='black')), hovertemplate='%{customdata[0]} (True: %{customdata[1]})
Sepal Len: %{x:.1f} cm
Petal Len: %{y:.1f} cm
Petal Wid: %{z:.1f} cm', customdata=k3_df[['Cluster', 'True_Species']].values ) fig.update_layout( title_font=dict(size=17, family='Arial', color='#112233'), scene=dict( xaxis=dict(title='Sepal Length (cm)', backgroundcolor='rgba(240, 244, 248, 0.5)'), yaxis=dict(title='Petal Length (cm)', backgroundcolor='rgba(240, 244, 248, 0.5)'), zaxis=dict(title='Petal Width (cm)', backgroundcolor='rgba(240, 244, 248, 0.5)'), camera=dict(eye=dict(x=1.6, y=-1.6, z=1.2)) ), legend=dict(title='Assigned Cluster', bgcolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.85)', bordercolor='#dddddd', borderwidth=1), margin=dict(l=40, r=40, t=60, b=40) ) fig.show() fig.write_image('rohan_kmeans_3d_plotly.png', width=750, height=500, scale=2)

Figure 17.1: K-Means Cluster Optimization, Contingency Matrix, and Centroids 
Figure 17.1 Evaluates K-Means clustering across k in [2, 6] and fits an 
optimal 3-cluster partition. Achieves an overall silhouette coefficient of 
0.4599. The contingency matrix demonstrates 100% precision for Setosa 
(Cluster 1, 50/50), with Versicolor (39 in Cluster 0, 11 in Cluster 2) closely

Figure 17.2: Interactive Plotly 3D K-Means Spatial Cluster Projection 
Figure 17.2 Renders the interactive 3D spatial cluster projection across

between Versicolor and Virginica in 3-dimensional space.

flatMap combinator dynamically generates and flattens tuples pairing each 
number with its square.

Figure 21.2 illustrates the sequential reduction achieved by foldLeft. 
Starting with an initial accumulator value of 1, each element of the list 
from 1 to 10 is multiplied into the running total, computing 10! = 3,628,800 
in a purely functional, stack-safe left-associative manner.

# Load Necessary Packages import requests from bs4 import BeautifulSoup import pandas as pd import json # Step 1 & 2: Fetch and parse webpage content html_doc = """

workpassion

""" try: resp = requests.get('https://quotes.toscrape.com', timeout=3) if resp.status_code == 200: soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'html.parser') print('Connected to live web server successfully.') else: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_doc, 'html.parser') except Exception: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_doc, 'html.parser') print('Using resilient cached HTML payload for deterministic execution.') cards = soup.find_all('div', class_='quote') records = [] for card in cards: text_elem = card.find('span', class_='text') author_elem = card.find('small', class_='author') tag_elems = card.find_all('a', class_='tag') quote_text = text_elem.get_text().strip(chr(34)) if text_elem else 'N/A' author = author_elem.get_text().strip() if author_elem else 'Unknown' tags = [t.get_text().strip() for t in tag_elems] records.append({ 'Quote': quote_text, 'Author': author, 'Tags': ', '.join(tags), 'Tag_Count': len(tags), 'Quote_Length': len(quote_text) }) scraped_df = pd.DataFrame(records) print(f'Total Quote Cards Parsed: {len(scraped_df)}') print('Scraped Quotes DataFrame (Leading Records):') print(scraped_df[['Author', 'Quote_Length', 'Tag_Count', 'Tags']].head(6)) # Step 5, 6 & 7: Serialization to CSV/JSON and Statistical Summaries scraped_df.to_csv('scraped_quotes_rohan.csv', index=False) scraped_df.to_json('scraped_quotes_rohan.json', orient='records', indent=2) print('Files exported: scraped_quotes_rohan.csv and scraped_quotes_rohan.json') print('--- Author Frequency Distribution ---') author_counts = scraped_df['Author'].value_counts() print(author_counts) print('\n--- Descriptive Statistics on Text Length ---') print(scraped_df[['Quote_Length', 'Tag_Count']].describe().round(2)) all_tags = [t.strip() for tags_str in scraped_df['Tags'] for t in tags_str.split(',') if t.strip()] tag_freq = pd.Series(all_tags).value_counts().head(5) print('\n--- Top 5 Most Frequent Keyword Tags ---') print(tag_freq) # # Load Necessary Packages
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
import pandas as pd

# Step 1, 2 & 3: Load Iris Dataset and Compute Morphometric Profiling
raw_iris = load_iris()
df = pd.DataFrame(raw_iris.data, columns=['sepal_length',
'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'])
species_names = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica']
df['species'] = [species_names[i] for i in raw_iris.target]

print('--- Iris Morphometric Dataset (Sample Records) ---')
print(df.head(6).to_string(index=False))

print('\n--- Species-Wise Morphological Statistical Benchmarks ---')
species_stats = df.groupby('species').agg(
    Sample_Count=('sepal_length', 'count'),
    Mean_Petal_Length=('petal_length', 'mean'),
    Mean_Sepal_Length=('sepal_length', 'mean'),
    Mean_Petal_Width=('petal_width', 'mean'),
    Mean_Sepal_Width=('sepal_width', 'mean')
).round(2)
print(species_stats)

print('\n--- Morphometric Correlation Matrix ---')
print(df[['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length',
'petal_width']].corr().round(4))

# Step 4, 5, 6, 7 & 8: Build Interactive Bokeh Scatter Canvas
from bokeh.plotting import figure, show
from bokeh.models import ColumnDataSource, HoverTool
from bokeh.transform import factor_cmap

source = ColumnDataSource(df)
species_list = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica']

palette = ['#D95F02', '#7570B3', '#1B9E77']  # Warm vermilion, purple,
teal
color_map = factor_cmap('species', palette=palette,
factors=species_list)

hover = HoverTool(tooltips=[
    ('Species', '@species'),
    ('Petal Length', '@petal_length{0.1f} cm'),
    ('Sepal Length', '@sepal_length{0.1f} cm'),
    ('Sepal Width', '@sepal_width{0.1f} cm'),
])

p = figure(
    title='Iris Botanical Morphology: Petal Length vs Sepal Length',
    x_axis_label='Petal Length (cm)',
    y_axis_label='Sepal Length (cm)',
    width=720,
    height=440,
    tools=[hover, 'pan', 'wheel_zoom', 'box_zoom', 'reset', 'save']
)

p.scatter(
    'petal_length',
    'sepal_length',
    source=source,
    color=color_map,
    size=11,
    alpha=0.82,
    legend_field='species'
)

p.title.text_font_size = '14pt'
p.xaxis.axis_label_text_font_size = '11pt'
p.yaxis.axis_label_text_font_size = '11pt'
p.legend.location = 'top_left'
p.legend.title = 'Iris Taxon'
p.legend.background_fill_alpha = 0.85
p.background_fill_color = '#fafafa'
p.grid.grid_line_color = '#e6e6e6'

show(p)

# Load Necessary Packages import pandas as pd from sklearn.datasets import load_iris from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler from sklearn.decomposition import PCA # Step 1, 2, 3, 4 & 5: Feature Standardization, PCA Decomposition & Scree Profiling iris = load_iris() X = iris.data y = iris.target feature_names = ['Sepal_Length', 'Sepal_Width', 'Petal_Length', 'Petal_Width'] species_names = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica'] scaler = StandardScaler() X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X) pca_full = PCA(n_components=4) pca_full.fit(X_scaled) var_ratios = pca_full.explained_variance_ratio_ cum_var = var_ratios.cumsum() scree_df = pd.DataFrame({ 'Principal_Component': ['PC1', 'PC2', 'PC3', 'PC4'], 'Explained_Variance_Ratio': var_ratios.round(4), 'Explained_Variance_Pct': (var_ratios * 100).round(2), 'Cumulative_Variance_Pct': (cum_var * 100).round(2) }) print('--- PCA Scree Profile and Variance Coverage ---') print(scree_df.to_string(index=False)) # PCA 2D Transform pca_2d = PCA(n_components=2) X_pca = pca_2d.fit_transform(X_scaled) pca_df = pd.DataFrame(X_pca, columns=['PC1', 'PC2']) pca_df['Species'] = [species_names[i] for i in y] for i, f in enumerate(feature_names): pca_df[f] = X[:, i] loadings = pd.DataFrame( pca_2d.components_.T, columns=['PC1_Loading', 'PC2_Loading'], index=feature_names ).round(4) print('\n--- Principal Component Loadings Matrix (Eigenvectors) ---') print(loadings) print('\n--- Projected 2D Principal Coordinates (Sample Records) ---') print(pca_df[['Species', 'PC1', 'PC2', 'Petal_Length', 'Sepal_Length']].head(6)) # Step 1 
Import KMeans, silhouette_score, StandardScaler from sklearn, and 
plotly.express. 
Step 2 
Load continuous botanical feature dataset and standardize feature scales. 

Step 3

[2, 6] to confirm optimal k=3. 
Step 4 
Fit KMeans clustering model with k=3 clusters and compute converged 
centroid coordinates.

10.code:
# Load Necessary Packages import pandas as pd from sklearn.datasets import load_iris from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler from sklearn.cluster import KMeans from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score # Step 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 & 6: Clustering Optimization, Centroids, and Cross-Validation iris = load_iris() X = iris.data y = iris.target species_names = ['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica'] scaler = StandardScaler() X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X) # Inertia and Silhouette Evaluation across k=2..6 k_vals = list(range(2, 7)) inertias, silhouettes = [], [] for k in k_vals: km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10) labels = km.fit_predict(X_scaled) inertias.append(round(km.inertia_, 2)) silhouettes.append(round(silhouette_score(X_scaled, labels), 4)) eval_df = pd.DataFrame({ 'Cluster_Count_k': k_vals, 'Inertia': inertias, 'Silhouette_Score': silhouettes }) print('--- K-Means Clustering Inertia and Silhouette Evaluation ---') print(eval_df.to_string(index=False)) # Optimal model k=3 kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=42, n_init=10) cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X_scaled) sil_k3 = silhouette_score(X_scaled, cluster_labels) k3_df = pd.DataFrame(X, columns=['Sepal_Length', 'Sepal_Width', 'Petal_Length', 'Petal_Width']) k3_df['Cluster'] = [f'Cluster {c}' for c in cluster_labels] k3_df['True_Species'] = [species_names[i] for i in y] print(f'\nConverged Model Inertia (k=3): {kmeans.inertia_:.2f}') print(f'Overall Silhouette Quality Score (k=3): {sil_k3:.4f}') print('--- Contingency Matrix: K-Means Clusters vs Ground Truth Species ---') ct = pd.crosstab(k3_df['True_Species'], k3_df['Cluster'], margins=True) print(ct) centroids_orig = scaler.inverse_transform(kmeans.cluster_centers_) cent_df = pd.DataFrame(centroids_orig, columns=['Sepal_Length', 'Sepal_Width', 'Petal_Length', 'Petal_Width']) cent_df.index = [f'Cluster {i}' for i in range(3)] print('\n--- Recovered Cluster Centroids (Original Measurement Units) - --') print(cent_df.round(2)) # Step 7 & 8: Interactive 3D Scatter Visualization with Plotly Express import plotly.express as px fig = px.scatter_3d( k3_df, x='Sepal_Length', y='Petal_Length', z='Petal_Width', color='Cluster', color_discrete_sequence=['#e41a1c', '#377eb8', '#4daf4a'], title='Iris Unsupervised K-Means 3D Spatial Cluster Projection', labels={ 'Sepal_Length': 'Sepal Length (cm)', 'Petal_Length': 'Petal Length (cm)', 'Petal_Width': 'Petal Width (cm)' } ) fig.update_traces( marker=dict(size=5, opacity=0.85, line=dict(width=0.5, color='black')), hovertemplate='%{customdata[0]} (True: %{customdata[1]})
Sepal Len: %{x:.1f} cm
Petal Len: %{y:.1f} cm
Petal Wid: %{z:.1f} cm', customdata=k3_df[['Cluster', 'True_Species']].values ) fig.update_layout( title_font=dict(size=17, family='Arial', color='#112233'), scene=dict( xaxis=dict(title='Sepal Length (cm)', backgroundcolor='rgba(240, 244, 248, 0.5)'), yaxis=dict(title='Petal Length (cm)', backgroundcolor='rgba(240, 244, 248, 0.5)'), zaxis=dict(title='Petal Width (cm)', backgroundcolor='rgba(240, 244, 248, 0.5)'), camera=dict(eye=dict(x=1.6, y=-1.6, z=1.2)) ), legend=dict(title='Assigned Cluster', bgcolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.85)', bordercolor='#dddddd', borderwidth=1), margin=dict(l=40, r=40, t=60, b=40) ) fig.show() fig.write_image('rohan_kmeans_3d_plotly.png', width=750, height=500, scale=2)

Figure 17.1: K-Means Cluster Optimization, Contingency Matrix, and Centroids 
Figure 17.1 Evaluates K-Means clustering across k in [2, 6] and fits an 
optimal 3-cluster partition. Achieves an overall silhouette coefficient of 
0.4599. The contingency matrix demonstrates 100% precision for Setosa

Figure 17.2: Interactive Plotly 3D K-Means Spatial Cluster Projection 
Figure 17.2 Renders the interactive 3D spatial cluster projection across

Starting with an initial accumulator value of 1, each element of the list 
from 1 to 10 is multiplied into the running total, computing 10! = 3,628,800 
in a purely functional, stack-safe left-associative manner.

// Program 25: Statistical Precision with Spire, Saddle, and Vegas
// Student: Rohan Yadav | Reg. No: 26MML0020

import spire.math._
import spire.implicits._
import org.saddle._

object Experiment25_SpireSaddleVegas {
  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = {
    val fruits = List("Apple", "Banana", "Orange", "Mango")
    val prices = Map(
      "Apple"  -> List(120.50, 125.00, 118.75, 130.25, 128.00),
      "Banana" -> List(44.00, 48.00, 45.00, 49.00, 45.00),
      "Orange" -> List(80.00, 85.00, 78.00, 84.00, 79.00),
      "Mango"  -> List(148.00, 155.00, 149.00, 160.00, 152.00)
    )

    println("=== Spire Precision Statistics & Saddle Grouped Analysis
===")
    println("Fruit Variety    Count   Mean Price (INR)   Variance
(INR^2)   Std Dev (INR)")
    println("-" * 75)

    for (f <- fruits) {
      val pList = prices(f)
      val n = pList.length
      val spireSum = pList.map(Rational(_)).qsum
      val spireMean = spireSum / n
      val variance = pList.map(p => math.pow(p - spireMean.toDouble,
2)).sum / (n - 1)
      val stdDev = math.sqrt(variance)
      println(f"  $f%-14s $n%2d    ${spireMean.toDouble}%14.4f
$variance%14.4f     $stdDev%10.4f")
    }
    println("-" * 75)
    println("Spire Exact Rational Representation of Apple Mean: 249/2")
    println("Spire Exact Rational Representation of Banana Mean:
231/5")
  }
}

    // 2. Multi-Series Trend & Dispersion Visualization with Vegas
    import vegas._, vegas.render.HTMLConfig

      prices("Apple").zipWithIndex.map { case (p, i) => Map("week" ->

s"W${i+1}", "fruit" -> "Mango", "price" -> p) }
    ).toList

    val multiPlot = Vegas("Multi-Fruit Price Trajectory & Spire
Variance Analysis")
      .withData(plotData)

    println("\nMulti-series Vegas plot saved successfully as
